notes.title: CRT effect & Italian Language added
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30354543/06aefca1cc75b6bdce594161a3ea12ac97d6bb24.jpg[/img]

Miow!
MagiCat now have CRT effect option that you can access in Setting.

Italian language also added into the game. 
This translation was made by a user by the name [b]hexaae[/b] and has been in Guides section for a while. We decided to include it to the main game so player doesn't need extra steps to play it in Italian.

Thanks for the translation, hexaae.

notes.title: Controller Icon
notes.content:
Button icon now properly show Controller icon when using controller.
You can set controller's icon type (XBOX / PS / SWITCH) from the controller setting.

notes.title: V-Sync option [Windows Ver.]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30354543/4a5ef5e193040c90fc32d3d3f686fc37882f71ce.jpg[/img]

Miaw!

V-Sync now can be enabled and disabled at Settings. 
For people who experienced FPS drop (game became slower), disabling or enabling this option might help to remove the problem. ːmagicatː

Note: This option are only available on Windows.

notes.title: Price drop and Switch release meow!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30354543/08169ef34a1caf6de1baaf653472cb1dfc2ce2bc.gif[/img]

Hello everyone!

We have a very good mews for you! As some of you might have noticed, starting today MagiCat got a purrmanent price drop from $7.99 to $4.99. This is not a discount or any kind of special deals, but a purrmanent change that will hopefully open the door of this game to many other humans and cats all around the world.

Why the sudden decision you ask? Because, as we have mewntioned in the previous announcement, MagiCat just celebrated its first anniversary on Steam, and just got released on Nintendo Switch today!

There's nothing different between both versions, so you can choose either version without having to worry getting left out from the other.

Thank you so much for your support until now, and enjoy your adventure meow!

notes.title: 1st anniversary and Switch port!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30354543/b9736ae57986328dae87dad86a77eb0b032d025b.png[/img]
Good day everyone!

You might not have noticed (even we almost skipped it), but today is the first anniversary of MagiCat release on Steam!

To celebrate this, we would like to announce that MagiCat is coming to Nintendo Switch soon! We don't have a release date yet, but do wait for the port to be out this year.

While we're at it, MagiCat is currently on sale as part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7880/Indienesia_Bundle__Games_Made_in_Indonesia/]Indienesia bundle[/url]. There are only a few hours left, so get it on discount while it last.

See you later meow!

notes.title: Two new updates regarding MagiCat!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30354543/ca4cf37a2ccc75f86c435f60fdce0c50e516419d.jpg[/img]

Hello, everyone!

How are you? Hope you all have a fantastic week meow!

This week we would like to announce two non-direct updates for MagiCat. Let’s get to it meow.

[b]The first one[/b] is we have a new demo for you to check out. If you already bought the game (thank you so much meow!), the new demo will not be anything new for you because the content is already there (if you can get to mid or later level meow). But if you are still deciding to purrr-chase the game or not, the demo might help you with your decision.

[b]The second update[/b] is starting today you can buy the soundtrack of the game meow! MagiCat Original Soundtrack consists of 24 songs that will take you on a nostalgia trip of the classic gaming era. You can [url=store.steampowered.com/app/658900/MagiCat_Original_Soundtrack/]get the soundtrack here[/url].

Hope you enjoy the game and the new stuff we just added.

See you later meow!

notes.title: Update 1.10
notes.content:
Ver 1.10
- Added [b]Check Point[/b] on the beginning of [b]each stage-part[/b]
- Reduce [b]Boss phase[/b] to just [b]4 phase[/b] (You can still fight 5 phase boss on New Game+)

I hope with this update, the frustrating part of the game is reduced.

Also some minor fix...
- Fix bug where you can still get damaged even after defeating the boss
- Fix bug where you can't jump from fence if using up on analog



Thanks for your support, keep the feedback coming meow~

- Reduce display memory usage

- Reset PAW needed for revive upon entering boss room

- Leaving a stage on Check Point now give you bonus
- Item on map is now auto-use
- Fix char getting damage when stomping at enemies
- Some stage design change
